text-primary.$description: Headings and body text on bg-primary, bg-secondary and bg-tertiary. Don't use on brand or inverse fills — use text-on-brand / text-inverse.

text-secondary.$description: Supporting copy, labels, descriptions and table cells on bg-primary and bg-secondary. Don't use for disabled text — use text-disabled.

text-white.$description: Always white in both themes — text on photos and fixed dark fills. Don't use on theme-aware surfaces — use text-primary or text-inverse.

text-opacity.$description: Text at 60% opacity over imagery or any background. Don't use for hint text on surfaces — use text-tertiary.

text-link.$description: Inline links on bg-primary and bg-secondary. Pair with an underline or hover change; don't use for non-interactive emphasis — use text-brand.

text-tertiary.$description: Hints, timestamps, metadata and helper text on bg-primary and bg-secondary. Don't use for body copy or placeholders.

text-placeholder.$description: Placeholder text inside inputs only, on bg-primary. Never use for labels or entered values.

text-disabled.$description: Labels of disabled controls; exempt from contrast rules. Don't use to de-emphasise active content — use text-tertiary.

text-brand.$description: Brand-coloured text: highlighted words and active nav labels on bg-primary and bg-brand-subtle. Don't use on bg-brand-solid — use text-on-brand.

text-on-brand.$description: Labels on bg-brand-solid (the primary button). Only on brand-solid fills.

text-error.$description: Error messages and destructive labels on bg-primary and bg-error-subtle. Don't use on bg-error-solid — use text-white.

text-warning.$description: Warning text on bg-primary and bg-warning-subtle. Don't use on bg-warning-solid — use text-on-warning.

text-success.$description: Success text on bg-primary and bg-success-subtle.

text-brand-hover.$description: Hover state of text-brand and text-link. Only for the hover state.

text-inverse.$description: Text on bg-inverse (tooltips, dark banners). Only on bg-inverse.

text-on-warning.$description: Text on bg-warning-solid (solid warning badges). Always Gray 900 — white on amber is only 2.2:1.

text-ai.$description: AI label text and AI accents ("AI generated", "Thought for 12s"). Meets 4.5:1 on bg-primary and bg-ai-subtle. Not for body copy. Value shown for the Atomus brand; code follows the active brand: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-300) 55%, var(--color-purple-300))

button-inv-border-active.$description: Component token: invisible (tertiary) button border — active state. Use only inside Button; in custom UI use the semantic Background / Text / Border roles.

button-link-text-hover.$description: Component token: link button label — hover state. Use only inside Button; in custom UI use the semantic Background / Text / Border roles.

button-link-border-active.$description: Component token: link button border — active state. Use only inside Button; in custom UI use the semantic Background / Text / Border roles.

button-link-border-hover.$description: Component token: link button border — hover state. Use only inside Button; in custom UI use the semantic Background / Text / Border roles.

button-disabled-color.$description: Component token: fill of disabled buttons. Aliases the disabled ramp; prefer bg-disabled in new code.

button-disabled-text.$description: Component token: label of disabled buttons. Prefer text-disabled in new code.

focus-s-spread.$description: Component token: spread of the small focus ring (2px).

focus-s-color.$description: Component token: colour of the small (2px) focus ring.

alert-brand-bg.$description: Alert background (Subtle style). Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-400) 14%, transparent) — brand-400 at 14% alpha.

alert-brand-border.$description: Alert hairline border. Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-400) 36%, transparent) — brand-400 at 36% alpha.

alert-brand-title.$description: Alert title, link and action text.

alert-brand-icon.$description: Alert status icon and close button.

alert-error-bg.$description: Alert background (Subtle style). Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-rose-400) 14%, transparent) — rose-400 at 14% alpha.

alert-error-border.$description: Alert hairline border. Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-rose-400) 36%, transparent) — rose-400 at 36% alpha.

alert-error-title.$description: Alert title, link and action text.

alert-error-icon.$description: Alert status icon and close button.

alert-warning-bg.$description: Alert background (Subtle style). Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-400) 14%, transparent) — amber-400 at 14% alpha.

alert-warning-border.$description: Alert hairline border. Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-amber-400) 36%, transparent) — amber-400 at 36% alpha.

alert-warning-title.$description: Alert title, link and action text.

alert-warning-icon.$description: Alert status icon and close button.

alert-success-bg.$description: Alert background (Subtle style). Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-green-400) 14%, transparent) — green-400 at 14% alpha.

alert-success-border.$description: Alert hairline border. Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-green-400) 36%, transparent) — green-400 at 36% alpha.

alert-success-title.$description: Alert title, link and action text.

alert-success-icon.$description: Alert status icon and close button.

alert-gray-bg.$description: Alert background (Subtle style). Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gray-400) 14%, transparent) — gray-400 at 14% alpha.

alert-gray-border.$description: Alert hairline border. Code: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-gray-400) 36%, transparent) — gray-400 at 36% alpha.

alert-gray-title.$description: Alert title, link and action text.

alert-gray-icon.$description: Alert status icon and close button.

primary-start.$description: Start stop of the primary gradient (hero and promo backgrounds). Decorative only — never behind body text without a scrim.

primary-end.$description: End stop of the primary gradient (hero and promo backgrounds). Decorative only.

secondary-start.$description: Start stop of the secondary gradient (hero and promo backgrounds). Decorative only.

secondary-end.$description: End stop of the secondary gradient (hero and promo backgrounds). Decorative only.

tertiary-start.$description: Start stop of the tertiary (neutral) gradient. Decorative only.

tertiary-end.$description: End stop of the tertiary (neutral) gradient. Decorative only.

ai.$description: AI gradient (var(--gradient-ai)): the sparkle mark, the AI glow ring of a focused prompt input and the shimmer of streaming text. Reserve it to identify AI; never decorate non-AI UI with it or put body text on it. Code: linear-gradient(135deg, brand-400 → brand-400/purple-400 35/65 → pink-300) at 135deg, following the active brand.

bg-primary.$description: Default page and card surface. Pair with text-primary and border-secondary.

bg-primary-hover.$description: Hover on rows, menu items and list items that sit on bg-primary. Only for hover, never as a resting fill.

bg-secondary.$description: Sidebars, section bands, table headers and subtle panels. Don't nest bg-secondary inside bg-secondary — step to bg-tertiary.

bg-tertiary.$description: Stronger neutral fill: chips, wells, tracks, image placeholders and secondary buttons.

bg-inverse.$description: Inverted surfaces: tooltips and dark banners. Always pair with text-inverse and fg-inverse.

bg-disabled.$description: Fill of disabled controls. Pair with text-disabled and border-disabled.

bg-brand-solid.$description: Primary brand fill: primary buttons, checked controls, progress fills, active states. Use text-on-brand / fg-on-brand on top; one primary action per view.

bg-brand-solid-hover.$description: Hover of bg-brand-solid. Only for the hover state.

bg-brand-subtle.$description: Light brand tint: selected rows, info areas, brand badges. Use text-brand or text-primary on top.

bg-error-solid.$description: Destructive buttons and error dots. Use text-white on top; reserve for destructive actions.

bg-error-subtle.$description: Error alert, field and badge background. Use text-error on top.

bg-warning-subtle.$description: Warning alert and badge background. Use text-warning on top.

bg-success-subtle.$description: Success alert and badge background. Use text-success on top.

bg-tertiary-hover.$description: Hover on bg-tertiary fills (secondary buttons, chips). Only for the hover state.

bg-warning-solid.$description: Solid warning fill: badges, dots. Use text-on-warning / fg-on-warning on top — never white.

bg-success-solid.$description: Solid success fill: badges, dots. Use text-white on top.

bg-overlay.$description: Scrim behind modals and drawers. Only for overlays, never as a surface.

bg-quaternary.$description: Strongest neutral fill: toggle tracks (off), slider and progress tracks.

bg-quaternary-hover.$description: Hover on bg-quaternary fills. Only for the hover state.

bg-ai-subtle.$description: AI surface tint: AI messages, reasoning, AI label chips and approval cards. Brand blended with purple so AI reads as related to, but distinct from, the brand. Pair with text-ai or text-primary. Value shown for the Atomus brand; code follows the active brand: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-400) 55%, var(--color-purple-400)) 12%, transparent)

border-primary.$description: Borders of inputs and outlined controls. Decorative strength (≈1.5:1) — always pair a control border with a visible label; use border-focus for focus.

border-secondary.$description: Card outlines, dividers and table rules. Don't use for input borders — use border-primary.

border-brand.$description: Selected / active border: selected cards, active tabs. Don't use for focus — use border-focus.

border-focus.$description: Focus outline colour of every interactive control; pair with the focus ring shadow. Only for :focus-visible.

border-error.$description: Inputs and cards in an error state. Pair with a text-error message.

border-warning.$description: Inputs, alerts and cards in a warning state.

border-success.$description: Inputs, alerts and cards in a success state.

border-ai.$description: Hairline border of AI surfaces (bg-ai-subtle) and AI label chips. Decorative: never the only signal that content is AI-generated — pair with the AI label. Value shown for the Atomus brand; code follows the active brand: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-400) 55%, var(--color-purple-400)) 40%, transparent)

fg-primary.$description: Primary icons and non-text graphics next to text-primary.

fg-secondary.$description: Secondary icons: inputs, nav items, buttons.

fg-tertiary.$description: Muted and decorative icons. Don't use for icons that are the only label of an action.

fg-brand.$description: Brand icons, featured-icon glyphs and active indicators. Don't use on bg-brand-solid — use fg-on-brand.

fg-on-brand.$description: Icons on bg-brand-solid fills. Only on brand-solid fills.

fg-on-warning.$description: Icons and dots on bg-warning-solid. Always Gray 900.

fg-contrast.$description: Maximum-contrast foreground: pure black in Light, pure white in Dark. For marks that must read on any surface (focus outlines on imagery, AI sparkle on gradients, overlays). Prefer fg-primary for ordinary icons.

fg-contrast-inverse.$description: Opposite of fg-contrast: pure white in Light, pure black in Dark. Use on fg-contrast / bg-inverse fills.
